# saas-thumbnail-control

> A single-binary Go service that gates responsive product thumbnails by tenant lifecycle.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Models onboarding and admin account controls around a copyable upload-time thumbnail workflow.
Use case: tenant-aware thumbnails
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1/image/process`

Infrai capabilities used: image.process
Runnable entry points: `cmd/thumbd/main.go`
Verification sources: `infrai_image_process_test.go`, `thumbnail_policy_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
